author: hdprajwal
abstract: An AI agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text. Based on Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing' guide maintained by WikiProject AI Cleanup. Detects and rewrites 31 patterns including significance inflation, promotional language, superficial -ing analyses, vague attributions, AI vocabulary, em dash overuse, rule of three, negative parallelisms, and Claude-specific tells. Includes a final anti-AI audit pass with a second rewrite to catch lingering AI-isms.
